description:
Get a specific product by ID from Holded.

Args:
  - product_id (string): The product ID to retrieve (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Product details including name, sku, price, stock, variants, and custom fields.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_invoicing_get_product
title: Get Holded Product
